pre_pass.name: resolve_role_type
pre_pass.action: scan rows; find rt_id where role == 'actress'

pre_pass.name: resolve_info_type
pre_pass.action: scan rows; find it_id where info == 'release dates'

pre_pass.name: resolve_keywords
pre_pass.output: small flat_array<int32> kw_ids (size up to 3); also bitset over keyword id range or linear scan since |kw_ids|<=3

pre_pass.name: resolve_us_code
pre_pass.action: read country_code dict to find dict code for '[us]'

pre_pass.name: resolve_f_code
pre_pass.action: read name.gender dict to find dict code for 'f'

pre_pass.name: build_valid_persons_bitset
pre_pass.action: scan name.gender and name.name; bitset valid_persons[p-1] = (gender == f_code) AND memmem(name, 'An')

pre_pass.name: build_note_set
pre_pass.action: construct flat_hash_set<string_view> of 4 literals: '(voice)','(voice: Japanese version)','(voice) (uncredited)','(voice: English version)'

join_order.notes: for each surviving t.id v, scan mk[lo..hi); filter keyword_id in kw_ids (linear over 3)
for each v that survived mk, scan mc[lo..hi); accept if valid_companies[company_id-1]
for each v that survived mc, scan mi[lo..hi); filter info_type_id==it_id AND info nonempty AND (memcmp prefix 'Japan:' OR 'USA:') AND memmem remainder '201'
for each v that survived mi, scan ci[lo..hi); filter role_id==rt_id AND person_role_id != INT32_MIN AND valid_persons[person_id-1] AND note_set.contains(note)
fetch chn.name via name.off[chn_id-1]..name.off[chn_id] for running MIN

filters.predicate: role_id==rt_id AND note IN 4-set AND valid_persons[person_id-1] AND person_role_id!=NULL

data_structures.aggregation: running MIN scalars (3 string_view via memcpy to local owned buffer on update)

parallelism.morsel: title id range; each thread maintains thread-local MIN strings then merged at end

indexes.purpose: offsets_only by t.id for mk scan
offsets_only by t.id for mc scan
offsets_only by t.id for mi scan
offsets_only by t.id for ci scan

join_order_rationale: Probe in order of cheapness/selectivity: mk first (only 3 kw_ids globally, kills nearly all titles), then mc (us bitset), then mi (info LIKE), then ci (heaviest fact). aka existence and chn fetch happen only for surviving ci rows.
